topic: Guess the Telugu movie from the clue — 4 eras (2022, 2006, 1957, 1980), easy to hard

slides.sub: 2022 → 2006 → 1957 → 1980. Pick A, B or C before you swipe!

slides.label: Q1 • EASY
slides.question_te: Oscar గెలిచిన పాట ఉన్న సినిమా ఏది?
slides.question_en: Dir. S. S. Rajamouli. Its song was the first song from an Indian film to win the Oscar for Best Original Song.

slides.en: The first song from an Indian film to win the Oscar for Best Original Song, at the 95th Academy Awards (12 Mar 2023).

slides.label: Q2 • MEDIUM
slides.question_en: Dir. Puri Jagannadh. Remade in Tamil (2007) and in Hindi as "Wanted" (2009).

slides.en: Puri Jagannadh's 2006 film was remade in Tamil (2007) and in Hindi as Wanted (2009).

slides.label: Q3 • HARD
slides.question_en: Dir. K. V. Reddy. Topped a 2013 CNN-IBN online poll of the greatest Indian films.

slides.en: K. V. Reddy's 1957 Mahabharata fantasy. Bonus: the first Telugu film to be digitally colourised, re-released in 2010.

slides.label: Q4 • HARDEST
slides.question_en: Dir. K. Viswanath. S. P. Balasubrahmanyam's first National Award for playback singing.

slides.te: SPB కి తొలి National Award ఈ సినిమాతోనే!
slides.en: K. Viswanath's 1980 film about a Carnatic music maestro gave S. P. Balasubrahmanyam his first National Award for playback singing.
